notes.title: Update 1.21 - Music Changes, What's Next
notes.notes:
Music is no longer random; track have been split up and are played depending on difficulties and certain attrition events



Our next sequence of updates is going to involve cleaning up and improving Grand Attrition's visuals, fixing bugs, and refining audio. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 1.12 - Mono Terrain Fix, Barbarian & Archer Changes
notes.notes:
Fixed maps infrequently generating only a single terrain type for 95-100% of the map
 Increased sine tile spawn rates by 300%
 Replaced the snail graphic with a shield graphic for mountain terrain's sprite effect
 Priests that spawn by enemy buildings at the start of the game now stay by them
 Barbarians now pause for a small amount of time when they reflect a projectile; the amount of time paused is based on projectile damage
 Archers now twitch for each arrow fired

notes.title: Update 1.11 - Bug Fixes, Enemy Building Slider
notes.notes:
Fixed hold ground “shield” sprite from popping up in the lower left corner of the screen upon unit spawn
 Fixed issue where barbarians lose their attack hitboxes randomly
 Fixed Door Terrors giving excessive extra death resource when sacrificed
 Fixed Unguarded wandering when they become old; they now automatically hold their ground instead
 Reduced generated resource amount by 10%
 Added slider for number of enemy buildings

notes.title: Update 1.10 - Rework Part 1
notes.notes:
Destroying all enemy buildings will result in the enemy commander unit spawning; this means players no longer have to wait out all nights before initiating an attrition’s climax
 Destroying enemy buildings now spawns 2-3 Unguarded units nearby
 Enemy unit squads now exclusively come from enemy buildings that spawn at the beginning of an attrition
 Enemy unit squad spawn chance increased by 33%
 The claimed tile defense bonus now scales with map size
 Claiming tiles now only costs 1 of each resource (excluding Magic and Death resource)
 Terrain generation resource and point of interest spawning bugs fixed
 Terrain tile effects scrapped and reworked; check out the new effects on the instructions screen!


Furthermore, we’re aware of maps sometimes spawning only one terrain, and that players are noticing a lack of sine tiles being generated; these issues should be fixed in the next update.

notes.title: Update 1.09 - Improved Terrain Generation, Composite Difficulty
notes.notes:
Updated terrain generation to have larger “biome” regions and look more natural
 Added “composite difficulty” text on the options screen; this is based off of most game options, and will declare how difficult an attrition may be
 Instructions screen now has a scrollbar (to make all instructions not shown more obvious)
 Gnomes are now always on top (and always visible) when colliding with other units
 Leviathans and dragons will now always be on the bottom when colliding with other units

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.notes:
Normal ranged units all move faster, and projectiles move father, at rank 1
 Fixed bug where necro’d units threw off unit counters
 Fixed an audio bug
 Building buttons now have tooltips
 Units spawned directly by the player now start at rank 3, up from rank 1

notes.title: Update 1.07 - Resource HUD, Resource Effects, Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Replaced the oil drum resource sprite with something that actually looks like an oil drum
 Gathering resources now creates a gathering effect every time a resource shakes
 Game no longer crashes when starting a very special attrition

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
Added a button that allows the user to select all of their units/buildings/walls by type (just try it out!)
 Hidden sidegrade visuals have been updated to be more distinct
 Quit button added in main menu
 Fixed physics bug which ended in the game crashing

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Added a bunch of dumb noises triggered on unit death
 Fixed bug where thieves were graphically brought out of invisibility when sidegraded
 Tightened Pointer Finger area of attack
 Fixed bug where Pointer Fingers weren’t dropping their actual projectile on targets
 Reduced reload time for archers by 17%

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Some sound effects will now have their volume based on distance from the player’s camera
 Added sound effects for ranking up and units converting to other teams
 Fixed bug where priests attempted to heal units they couldn’t normally see
 Fixed bug where dead buildings were taking power ups
 Fixed bug where builds and walls weren’t playing the death sound effect when destroyed

notes.title: 1.03 Update
notes.notes:
The number of units currently selected by the player is now displayed at the top of the screen
 Lightning units are now immune to natural lightning strikes
 Wizards now level twice as slowly as other normal units
 Entity selection (selecting all entities/only units/only buildings/only walls)  may now be specified by a new button in the lower left corner of the screen during an attrition
 Fixed bug involving turning music off
 Minor optimizations to game performance
 Fixed bug causing game to crash during attritions
 Altered blood effect on unit death

notes.title: 1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Added three additional music tracks
 Options screen now informs the user of Grand Attrition’s estimated game performance
 Right clicking a talent with one or more talent points on the talents screen will extract a talent point
 Simple Walls: Health regen is now 3hp/sec; previously was 1hp/sec
 Tempered Walls: Health regen is now 6hp/sec; previously was 3hp/sec
 Living Walls: Maximum health is now 500hp; previously was 375hp
 Vampirism: Speed boost is now +20%; previously was +30%. Damage taken from healing projectiles increased to +500% base damage; previously was +300% base damage.

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Difficulty slider now scales with number of difficulties completed
 Buildings and walls now snap to a grid when placed
 Options screen now displays game length in hours/minutes/seconds

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Grand Attrition is now available to play!

Thank you to all who supported this game's development. 

Players, your feedback is sought after and highly valued. Aside from our developer's distended and maniacal ideas, Grand Attrition is foreseen to be also largely shaped by player influence.

Have fun!
